proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Chest freezer in the basement holding a quarter of beef and two seasons of pheasant, reading 25 degrees. They gave us the first slot the next morning, found a bad start relay, and nothing thawed.
reviews.name: Becky O.

reviews.text: Garage fridge kept the pop cold but the freezer side was soft every January. Lars explained the thermostat sits in the fridge section and the cold garage was fooling it. A small kit, no new fridge.
reviews.name: Trent A.

reviews.text: Family of seven, washer runs four loads a day. The bearings were roaring. He was straight with us that the repair made sense one time, and showed the kids how to load it so the drum stays balanced.
reviews.name: Joanna V.

reviews.text: Dryer vent on our Tea new build runs twenty-two feet up to the roof and it was packed solid with lint. Towels dry in one cycle again.
reviews.name: Marcus G.

reviews.text: Dishwasher in our farmhouse kitchen left a film on everything. Worn spray arm and the wrong rinse setting for our water. He fixed one and showed me the other, no talk of a new machine.
reviews.name: Ingrid S.

reviews.text: Upright freezer alarm went off during a blizzard week. They talked me through keeping the door shut over the phone, then came out and replaced the fan motor once the roads opened.
reviews.name: Wade F.

reviews.text: Oven was running about thirty degrees cold, and I bake bread every Saturday. He tested the sensor, swapped it and left a little note with the new readings taped inside the drawer.
reviews.name: Ruth K.

proof.guarantee: If the part we put in fails within 90 days, we come back and make it right at no charge.
